description: Select the table data to display in the list.
label: Table
name: table

description: Users can edit or remove this filter. If you set a fixed filter, this filter adds more conditions that further specify which records to display.
label: Filter
name: filter

description: Maximum number of rows to be rendered. When there is pagination component on the page, this property applies on a per-page basis.
label: Number of displayed rows
name: rowLimit

description: The current page index. Page 0 corresponds to the first page of data.
label: Current page
name: currentPage

description: A prop used for refreshing the list data
label: List refresh
name: listRefresh
